name: pl-whisper
title: Whisper large-v3: each recording transcribed
description: Whisper large-v3, through faster-whisper, over every recording of an input tree: a ChRIS DS plugin on pl-shexec

parameters.name: maxDepth
parameters.help: levels to descend; -1 for all

parameters.name: inputFile
parameters.help: list only files whose name contains this

parameters.name: fileFilter
parameters.help: comma-separated file tokens (see --man)

parameters.name: fileFilterLogic
parameters.help: combine file tokens with AND or OR (default OR) [choices: AND, OR, and, or]

parameters.name: dirFilter
parameters.help: comma-separated directory tokens (see --man)

parameters.name: dirFilterLogic
parameters.help: combine directory tokens with AND or OR (default OR) [choices: AND, OR, and, or]

parameters.name: outputLeafDir
parameters.help: template for each output leaf name; %%s is the input leaf, e.g. 'anon-%%s'

parameters.name: relativeDir
parameters.help: key the tree by relative paths

parameters.name: followLinks
parameters.help: follow symbolic links

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.help: allow overwriting existing output

parameters.name: verbosity
parameters.help: 0 silences the console

parameters.name: json
parameters.help: print the full result as JSON

parameters.name: printElapsedTime
parameters.help: print the run time

parameters.name: man
parameters.help: show the full manual and exit

parameters.name: synopsis
parameters.help: show the brief manual and exit

parameters.name: testRun
parameters.help: run the demonstration callbacks

parameters.name: analyzeFileIndex
parameters.help: which files per directory the analyze step gets: a (all), f, l, m, v (per volume), or an index

parameters.name: exec
parameters.help: the command to run per file, a pftag template (required): %%{inputWorkingDir}, %%{inputWorkingFile}, %%{outputWorkingDir}; functions pipe, as %%{inputWorkingFile|rmext}; every tag under --man TAGS

parameters.name: noJobLogging
parameters.help: keep no record of the jobs; the default is one JSON line per job in jobs.jsonl

parameters.name: jobFiles
parameters.help: also write each job as <file>-cmd, -stdout, -stderr, -returncode beside its result
